say:1:1861112001:0.text: With that, Fall Harvest is officially in full swing in Novaris.
say:1:1861112001:0.source_cn: 诺珐斯的秋夜狂欢正式拉开了序幕。

say:2:1861112002:1.text: Pumpkin lanterns cast a warm orange glow over the once cold, dark streets. The docks, the market, and even the outer walls of the Seasong Theater are covered in vibrant festival decorations.
say:2:1861112002:1.source_cn: 原本阴冷幽暗的街道，此刻被成百上千盏南瓜灯点亮，橘色的...

say:3:1861112003:1.text: The streets are teeming with Graveborn in costumes, mingling and exchanging candy. Everyone is eagerly looking forward to Senea's show.
say:3:1861112003:1.source_cn: 人群熙熙攘攘，穿着奇装异服的亡灵们在街头欢笑着交换糖果...

say:6:1861112004:0.text: Look! That house has a pumpkin lantern lit! Let's go knock!
say:6:1861112004:0.source_cn: 哇！前面那户人家的南瓜灯亮了！快去敲门！

say:7:1861112005:0.text: Haha, don't worry! I've got plenty of candy for everyone tonight!
say:7:1861112005:0.source_cn: 哈哈，别急别急，今天可是秋夜节，每个人都有！

say:11:1861112006:0.text: What do you think Senea will perform tonight?
say:11:1861112006:0.source_cn: 你猜猜塞涅晚上会表演什么呢？

say:16:1861112008:0.text: Silvina, this candy actually smells like books...
say:16:1861112008:0.source_cn: 姐姐，这颗糖里面封存了书卷的香气……

say:17:1861112009:0.text: If you like it, we can grab a few more from that stall over there.
say:17:1861112009:0.source_cn: 喜欢的话，我们再去前面的摊位买几颗。

choice_prompt:18:1861112009.text: If you like it, we can grab a few more from that stall over there.
choice_prompt:18:1861112009.source_cn: 喜欢的话，我们再去前面的摊位买几颗。

say:25:1861112012:0.text: Are those candle blossoms?! How on earth did you get infected?
say:25:1861112012:0.source_cn: 赤烛蕊？！怎么会突然感染——

say:26:1861112013:0.text: Gotcha! These flowers are fake! This is just a costume.
say:26:1861112013:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈！骗你们的！这只是我临时做的变装道具而已！

say:27:1861112014:0.text: Look at you two! Face as white as a sheet! Guess these flowers really can pass for the real thing.
say:27:1861112014:0.source_cn: 怎么样？是不是很逼真？把你们都吓到了吧！

say:28:1861112015:0.text: ... You really have pranking people down to a fine art, Estrilda.
say:28:1861112015:0.source_cn: ……这孩子的恶作剧也是越来越熟练了。

say:31:1861112016:0.text: Muahahaha! The pumpkin spirit is here! Tremble, everyone!
say:31:1861112016:0.source_cn: 哇哈！颤抖吧！南瓜恶灵来了！

say:33:1861112017:0.text: Good evening, everyone... Igor, knock it off.
say:33:1861112017:0.source_cn: 大家晚上好……伊戈尔，别吓到别人了。

say:36:1861112018:0.text: Valka, that armor looks amazing on you!
say:36:1861112018:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡小姐的这身盔甲真气派。

say:40:1861112019:0.text: Wait, it looks like everyone is dressed up except Baden and Thane. We can't have that, can we?
say:40:1861112019:0.source_cn: 说起来，大家今天好像都变装了，只有巴登和瑟恩还穿着平时...

say:41:1861112020:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!
say:41:1861112020:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!
say:41:1861112020:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!

choice_prompt:42:1861112020.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!
choice_prompt:42:1861112020.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，快用你的魔法帮他们变个装吧！越夸张越好！
choice_prompt:42:1861112020.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!
choice_prompt:42:1861112020.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you use magic to give them a makeover? The bolder, the better!

say:43:1861112021:0.text: You cast a shapeshifting spell on both Baden and Thane.
say:43:1861112021:0.source_cn: 你施展了幻化魔法，紧接着，巴登和瑟恩的身上发生了奇妙的变化。
say:43:1861112021:0.male: You cast a shapeshifting spell on both Baden and Thane.
say:43:1861112021:0.female: You cast a shapeshifting spell on both Baden and Thane.

say:46:1861112022:0.text: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what on earth did you do to me? I feel like I'm looking through a slit!
say:46:1861112022:0.male: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what on earth did you do to me? I feel like I'm looking through a slit!
say:46:1861112022:0.female: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what on earth did you do to me? I feel like I'm looking through a slit!

say:47:1861112023:0.text: Pfft! Oh my goodness, Thane! Your head's turned into a giant pumpkin!
say:47:1861112023:0.source_cn: 噗——哈哈哈！瑟恩，你的头变成了一个巨大的南瓜头！

say:49:1861112025:0.text: I think it suits you, Thane! Wait... why does my body feel so stiff? I can barely walk!
say:49:1861112025:0.source_cn: 相信我，瑟恩，这确实挺适合你的。不过……为什么我感觉我...

say:50:1861112026:0.text: Hahahaha! You're a walking tombstone now, Baden! You've even got moss growing on you!
say:50:1861112026:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！因为巴登你变成了一块会走路的墓碑啊！上面还长...

say:51:1861112027:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we can't go around looking like this. Do us a favor and lift the spell.
say:51:1861112027:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we can't go around looking like this. Do us a favor and lift the spell.
say:51:1861112027:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we can't go around looking like this. Do us a favor and lift the spell.

say:52:1861112028:0.text: I don't mind it, Thane. After all, we don't get to be a walking tombstone and a giant pumpkin every day!
say:52:1861112028:0.source_cn: 没关系，瑟恩，既然是节日，偶尔体会一下当墓碑和南瓜头的...

say:56:1861112030:0.text: No way! A giant pumpkin head and a walking tombstone? Let me see if I can jump over both of you at once!
say:56:1861112030:0.source_cn: 哇！巨大南瓜头！会走路的墓碑！我想试试一次能跳过几个！

say:57:1861112031:0.source_cn: 你看，不止我一个人这么觉得吧？

say:58:1861112032:0.text: As everyone laughs except Thane, you move with the crowd toward the brightly lit Seasong Theater.
say:58:1861112032:0.source_cn: 在众人的欢声笑语和瑟恩无奈的叹息中，你们跟随着拥挤的人...
say:58:1861112032:0.male: As everyone laughs except Thane, you move with the crowd toward the brightly lit Seasong Theater.
say:58:1861112032:0.female: As everyone laughs except Thane, you move with the crowd toward the brightly lit Seasong Theater.

choice:42:1:2.text: I'll make sure they look festive.
choice:42:1:2.source_cn: 给你们来点符合节日气氛的
choice:42:1:2.male: I'll make sure they look festive.
choice:42:1:2.female: I'll make sure they look festive.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯今晚还真是热闹

choice:18:1:2.text: Everyone seems to be having a great time.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 大家都很享受这个节日
choice:18:1:2.male: Everyone seems to be having a great time.
choice:18:1:2.female: Everyone seems to be having a great time.
